newsitem.title: USA: Natgas futures tank late, settle near lows.
newsitem.headline: Natgas futures tank late, settle near lows.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natural gas futures tanked late Monday and settled near the day's lows, hit by some technical selling and prospects for more mild weather ahead, industry sources said.
October tumbled 9.2 cents to close at $1.873 per million British thermal units. November settled 10.5 cents lower at $2.072. Other deferreds ended down by one-half to 10.8 cents.

"When there was no bounce this afternoon, it started to fall apart, then we broke the up trendline which accelerated the selling. If there are no heating or cooling loads, storage (buying) is not enough," said one Midwest trader.
Most agreed that early next month falling cooling loads and tapering injections were likely to keep physical and paper prices on the defensive near-term.

Technically, traders said November's break and close Monday below the short-term up trendline should lead to a test of next support in the $2.00 area. Further support was seen at the recent low of $1.90. Resistance was pegged at the recent high of $2.305.

Cash sources said Gulf Coast prices mostly were up slightly Monday to the high-$1.80s, with swing gas at the Hub talked in the $1.91-1.93 area. Midcon pipes also firmed slightly to the mid-$1.70s. New York city gate gas scored similar gains to the $2.10-2.15 area, with October quoted at NYMEX plus 19 cents.
The 12-month Henry Hub strip tumbled 5.4 cents to $2.054. NYMEX said 45,214 Henry Hub contracts traded, up from Friday's revised tally of 41,872.
NYMEX October Henry Hub natgas expires Tuesday, Sept 24.
NYMEX October Permian natgas was untraded but settled five cents lower at $1.64. NYMEX said three Permian contracts traded versus 55 on Friday.
NYMEX October Permian natgas expires Thursday, Sept 26.

On the KCBT, October finished five cents lower at $1.69, while deferreds ended down by two to nine cents. The East/West spread narrowed by 4.2 cents to 18.3 cents (NYMEX premium). KCBT October natgas expires Wednesday, Sept 25.
